name: --disable
description: Force-disable a named Codex feature flag for this invocation. Repeat the option to disable multiple features.

examples.explanation: Start Codex with shell snapshots disabled for this invocation.

when_to_use: Test behavior without a feature while leaving persisted configuration unchanged.

name: --enable
description: Force-enable a named Codex feature flag for this invocation. Repeat the option to enable multiple features.

examples.explanation: Start Codex with shell snapshots enabled for this invocation.

when_to_use: Test or temporarily activate a documented feature without changing persisted configuration.

name: --image
description: Attach one or more local image paths to the initial prompt. Supply comma-separated paths or repeat the option.

examples.explanation: Attach a screenshot to the opening prompt.

when_to_use: Include screenshots, diagrams, or other local images in the initial request.

name: --local-provider
description: Select the local provider used with --oss. Documented values are lmstudio and ollama.

examples.explanation: Run with a local model served by Ollama.

when_to_use: Choose which supported local provider backs an OSS-model session.

conditions: Requires --oss and a running supported local provider.

name: --no-alt-screen
description: Run the TUI without the terminal alternate-screen buffer, overriding tui.alternate_screen for the invocation.

examples.explanation: Keep Codex output in normal terminal scrollback.

when_to_use: Preserve terminal scrollback or work around alternate-screen behavior in a terminal multiplexer.

name: --oss
description: Use a locally served open-source model, with the provider selected from configuration or --local-provider.

examples.explanation: Start a local-model Codex session with an initial prompt.

when_to_use: Run Codex against a configured supported local model provider.

conditions: Requires a running supported local model provider.

name: --profile
description: Layer the named profile configuration from the Codex home directory onto the invocation.

examples.explanation: Start Codex using the review profile.

when_to_use: Switch between reusable configuration sets without editing the base config.

conditions: The named profile must exist in the Codex home directory.

name: --remote
description: Connect the CLI to a Codex app-server endpoint using ws, wss, or a Unix socket endpoint.

examples.explanation: Connect to an app server listening on the local port documented by the app-server example.

when_to_use: Run the CLI as a client of an existing Codex app server.

conditions: Requires an accessible Codex app-server endpoint.

name: --remote-auth-token-env
description: Read the bearer token for a --remote app-server connection from the named environment variable.

examples.explanation: Pass a locally exported token through an environment variable rather than the command line.

when_to_use: Authenticate a remote app-server connection without placing the token directly in the command line.

conditions: Requires --remote; supported with wss endpoints and local ws endpoints.
